besluite.fout: 'die neus self draai' can be misread as 'turn the nose itself' rather than 'the pilot himself turns the nose'.
besluite.rede: Placing 'self' before the object removes the ambiguity and echoes 'self besluit' in the previous sentence without moving the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'het, het' collision and the literal 'die lug in 'n pad verander' read stiff at the close of the lesson.
besluite.rede: 'Van die lug 'n pad maak' is the natural Afrikaans form of the image, keeps 'so' and the same people and claim, and touches no protected wording.
